title: Intrinsic Restriction Traces and Toric Dynamics
summary: We prove Morita invariance of the Campbell--Lind--Malkiewich--Ponto--Zakharevich restriction-system trace after passage to perfect modules. It therefore defines an intrinsic integral restriction trace for an exact endofunctor of a small idempotent-complete stable $\infty$-category. On $π_0$, the $m$-th ghost is the laced trace of the $m$-fold iterate, compatibly with Frobenius. For lattice-graded algebras, the ghost targets have twisted cocenters in degree zero; over the open parameter torus, this applies to the cyclic bimodule of Dinkins--Karpov--Krylov.
